author: Mark Atwood
text: Sibling-propagation note for q2wa.18: The doc rewrite of MailBackend::supports_type in crate-jmap-mail-server (commit on main) needs propagation to the same method in chat-server, calendars-server, contacts-server, tasks-server, filenode-server, metadata-server, sharing-server. The false 'NOT called internally' claim is workspace-wide; the 'stateless because global, not per-account' framing is workspace-wide; the types-in-scope enumeration must be adapted to each crate's RFC.
